title: Enthusia
body:
![Banner of Spawn](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/028b21dfb851c4683f32e79695f554268034651d.jpeg)
Looking for a long-term, community-driven server where every playstyle matters? Enthusia SMP is built carefully with custom plugins, player feedback, and a simple ruleset that keeps the game open, fun, and fair. After multiple Open Betas Enthusia is now fully released! Here are the world borders:
### Overworld
- 100k 
### Nether
- 12.5k
### End
- 50k

## Specific Features
- Custom guild system
- Player bounties
- Custom item-for-item trade shops
- Player-driven market stalls
- Safe spawn zone; PvP outside
- Random Events (Blockparty, Skywars, and more)
- Multiple combat zones (Crystal, Mace, Cart/Cobweb, and more)
- Build freely anywhere outside spawn
- No resets ever
- No pay-to-win — cosmetics only
- Community polls and feedback every update

Join our [discord](https://discord.gg/uFWpE8mpKz) to get updates regarding the server and to stay connected with the community of Enthusia!
